notes.content:

If you've ever wanted to jump into the SteamWorld universe, there's no better time than now!

[u]SteamWorld Build[/u]
First up, [b]SteamWorld Build[/b] is an astounding [b]80% off![/b] That's right, you can dive into the dusty depths, manage your mines, and build a thriving town for a fraction of the price. The critically acclaimed [b]SteamWorld Dig 2[/b] is practically giving itself away at a massive [b]94% off![/b] If you haven't experienced this gem of a platformer, now's your chance to dig, explore, and upgrade your way through a fantastic world. Plus, the [b]SWD2 Soundtrack[/b] is a whopping [b]90% off[/b] – perfect for setting the mood for your underground adventures.

[u]SteamWorld Dig[/u]
For the ultimate treat: [b]SteamWorld Dig is FREE on Steam![/b] That's right, completely, totally, absolutely FREE until June 26th, so you can snag the original classic that started it all.

notes.title: Pre-Order SteamWorld Heist II Now!

[b]SteamWorld Heist II is now available for pre-order on Nintendo Switch, Playstation, and Xbox! 
[/b]

Check out our [url=https://youtu.be/AwRK-aXsvLI]Gameplay Deep Dive[/url] to learn all about the ricochet-rich gunplay, all-new job system, and enemies you’ll face in Heist II.

notes.title: WE NEED YOU!!!
notes.content:
[h3]Share your thoughts on SteamWorld with us![/h3]

We’d love to hear from our fans and players, so we’re going to be running some online research in the USA into [b]SteamWorld[/b] next month. 

We’ve asked market research agency, Simpson Carpenter and Growmotion, to run some online focus groups in the USA on [b]7th February[/b].

There are two groups which will last for two hours and places will be on a first come, first served basis. If you’d like to take part, please register your interest on the link below that will take you to a short survey to register your interest. 

There will be other opportunities in the future if you can’t take part this time.

Places are limited, so if you do want to take part, we recommend filling this in sooner rather than later. 

You can be [b]anywhere in the USA[/b] as long as you can take part in the online research with a stable internet connection, microphone and camera on your computer.

notes.title: Race To The Finish In The First SteamWorld Dig 2 Speedrun Contest
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29333496/30a16743ed3b140e557b7cc9a75a9ecabc2299fb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Howdy, partners![/h1]

Together with the [url=https://www.ultimedecathlon.com/en/]Ultime Decathlon[/url] team we’re proud to present the first ever [b]SteamWorld Dig 2 Speedrun Contest[/b]! The contest is free to enter and open to anyone who wants to take on the challenge and/or be part of our amazing community of SWD2 speedrunners!

Check out the announcement trailer here: https://youtu.be/GsR8LX8d14U

[h1]What’s it all about?[/h1]
Speedrunning is simple in theory but tough to master. It’s all about beating a game as fast possible. The four fastest players to beat SWD2 during the qualifiers will gain access to the tournament final, which will take place on December 3 in a cinema in France!

This final will be broadcast in French and English. The same thing goes for the qualifiers on November 5 and November 12.

[h1]What you can win[/h1]
There is a ton of cool prizes for the lucky winners, including SteamWorld merch and a rare chance to meet the developers of the game!

[h1]Where to watch and how to enter[/h1]
Please visit the event’s [url=https://swd2.ultimedecathlon.com/]official website[/url] for all info about the contest. Please read the rules carefully if you decide to enter.

[h1]In need of inspiration?[/h1]
Check out this [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TpmSVkgFpxY]YouTube video[/url] in case you want to see a great SWD2 speedrun in action. It’s full of spoilers and magic moves (you’ve been warned).

notes.title: SteamWorld Dig 2 Hits PC, Mac and Linux!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29333496/9fe536bd98d6b8f0c35f6d7e9f404d6ced30da88.png[/img]

[b]Howdy, and welcome to the official SteamWorld Dig 2 Steam page![/b]

It’s my absolute pleasure to announce that SteamWorld Dig 2 is coming to Steam for Windows, Mac and Linux in 2017. Due to popular demand from fans of the original, we’re (finally) revisiting the mysterious and unresolved setting for SteamWorld Dig.

Here's the official game description:

[i]"Grab your pickaxe and dig into the sequel to the award-winning SteamWorld Dig! A platform mining adventure forged in Metroidvania flames.

In search of her lost friend, a lone steambot and her unlikely companion must dig deep, gain riches and explore an underworld riddled with danger. But time is running short..."[/i]

SWD2 will be much longer than the original and answer every possible question you could have from playing our previous SteamWorld games. We will share more cool info in the months up until release.

[b]Howdy, and welcome to the official SteamWorld Dig 2 Steam page![/b]

It’s my absolute pleasure to announce that SteamWorld Dig 2 is coming to Steam for Windows, Mac and Linux in 2017. Due to popular demand from fans of the original, we’re (finally) revisiting the mysterious and unresolved setting for SteamWorld Dig.

Here's the official game description:

[i]"Grab your pickaxe and dig into the sequel to the award-winning SteamWorld Dig! A platform mining adventure forged in Metroidvania flames.

In search of her lost friend, a lone steambot and her unlikely companion must dig deep, gain riches and explore an underworld riddled with danger. But time is running short..."[/i]
